thread:
Samira (People Ops): quick brainstorm — I sketched a 1-page "pocket guide" for goal-setting and quick self-review prompts that managers + ICs can paste into slack before a 1:1 :seedling:
Jordan (Eng Manager): love that. want the manager prompts and IC prompts separate? maybe a tiny checklist for calibration too
Samira (People Ops): yup — split. manager side = 3 actions (align scope, set measurables, coaching note). IC side = 3 bullets (impact story, tradeoffs, ask). calibration = 2 quick signals (variance vs expectation, evidence list)
Eli (IC): can you add a tiny example for a "feature work" OKR? i.e., what an outcome + metric looks like in one line
Samira (People Ops): good call. example added: "Outcome: Reduce checkout latency to <300ms for 95th pct; Metric: 95th latency from 380ms -> 280ms; Owner: Eli; Target quarter: Q2"
Jordan (Eng Manager): also include a 2-line script managers can say in 1:1s for nudging upward stretch without pressure. (e.g., "what would you try if you knew you couldn't fail?")
Samira (People Ops): added micro-script: "one-step bigger bet" prompt: "What's one slightly bolder thing we could try this quarter? What support would you need?"
HR Bot: reminder — check goal guidance doc when publishing: https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/goals (auto-note)
Eli (IC): nice. can we have a short copy for self-review that fits in a PR description? like 2 lines max
Samira (People Ops): yep — self-review PR blurb: "Top outcome I owned this cycle: <one sentence>. Evidence: <link(s)> and metric(s). Biggest learning and next-step."
Jordan (Eng Manager): perfect. any suggested cadence / timeline to send this before calibration? 
Samira (People Ops): recommend managers share goal snapshot + ask for IC self-review 7 days before calibration window. managers submit summaries 2 days after receiving self-reviews. keeps things moving and short
Eli (IC): throw in a sanity check for stretch goals: "is this 20-50% harder than last cycle?" That helps avoid moonshots or autopilot goals
Samira (People Ops): good tip — added a quick rubric: "Conservative (maintain), Stretch (20–50% growth), Moonshot (>50% and risky)"
Jordan (Eng Manager): can we get this as a tiny paste-ready block for Slack threads? I.e., copy/paste into a 1:1 note
Samira (People Ops): will do. Draft below (feel free to copy):

--- paste-ready manager checklist ---
Manager: 3 things to cover in 1:1
- Align scope: confirm priorities and dependencies
- Measurables: agree on 1–2 success metrics and target
- Coaching: ask the "one-step bigger" question

--- paste-ready IC self-review (2 lines) ---
- One-line outcome: <what I shipped> + metric
- Evidence & learning: <links> • <what I'd change next>

--- calibration quick signals ---
- Signal A: variance vs expectation (>= +20% or -20%)
- Signal B: top evidence list (links to PRs, dashboards, user feedback)

--- end paste ---

Jordan (Eng Manager): 👍 this is exactly the kind of short cheat-sheet I can send to my team. thanks Samira
Samira (People Ops): sweet — i'll upload to the goals hub and drop the link in the quarterly calibration channel after a few edits :sparkles:
